scope: normal native CLI discover plus five-band catalog discovery and original provider acquisition; every output array exactly matches independently validated replay

routing.rationale: Qualified credential-free discovery is preferred; no conclusive material authenticated-route advantage is established.

routes.discovery: bounded complete STAC search; hls2-l30/hls2-s30 only for HLS v2
routes.access: accountless memory-only SAS signing; observed container read/list grant; engine requests remain confined to the exact canonical object with conditional byte ranges
routes.capabilities: native COG; physical metadata and ETag validation before/after acquisition
routes.availability: queried AOI/date only; catalog coverage is independent of Earthdata; no global coverage claim
routes.limitations: requires signing service; HLS cross-provider equivalence is specimen-scoped; no online speed probe or fallback

eligibility.other_catalogs: not queried; supplied sources and explicit overrides never trigger substitution

equivalence.scope: Physical product identity is validated for every source. Matching product names or timestamps alone never establish cross-provider equivalence; no observation is replaced.

routing.pinning: provider, unsigned canonical locator, product/granule/band, access-policy version and inspected object ETag/grid/dtype/metadata are bound to this prepared acquisition; see sources for exact identities
routing.fallback: disabled; signature renewal/provider change requires an explicit fresh plan; product checkpoints are unsupported
